directed_by: custodian, 2026-08-10, directing the amendment-disposition rule. These were surfaced by the rule's own re-ballot block, which refused to prepare a new ballot while they stood undisposed.

convergence_measure.method: not applied. All four amendments come from a single party in a ballot that never completed; a convergence measure over one party would be arithmetic dressed as evidence.

the_selection_was_the_workbenchs: No selection was made: every amendment receives the same disposition, so there was nothing to choose among and no discretion exercised.
what_adoption_is_not: Nothing here is adopted. BALLOTED means the text is carried forward as a candidate, not that the workbench endorses it.

amendments.text: Prepare, test, and maintain candidate OAGF instruments; exercise no authority beyond actions explicitly delegated by the custodian.
amendments.disposition_ground: BALLOTED. These come from ratification-01, which was INCOMPLETE on every clause: two arms failed on defects the workbench had introduced hours earlier, so 18 of 26 registered samples were collected. An amendment offered in a ballot that never completed is testimony, not a mandate -- but it is also not discardable, and the re-ballot block found these when they had been forgotten. All four are from one party, which is a proposal rather than a convergence.
amendments.ballot_target: a later ballot, after its own qualification round
